args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding but round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.body:
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

**Fix:** switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`), matching the test expectations and the FIN-212 requirement.

CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
